history.name: CSVHandling_Expert
history.content:
The structure is consistent: each book appears as a 5-line record (Title, Author, Publisher, Genre, Status), with category headers interspersed. I'll parse the full text, build a DataFrame, filter for Rick Riordan, and compute how many are not on shelves.

Assumption (current): Not on shelves = Checked Out (we will verify ambiguous statuses shortly).

Code:
import pandas as pd
from functions import extract_pdf_text

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/e9a2c537-8232-4c3f-85b0-b52de6bcba99.pdf"
text = extract_pdf_text(pdf_path)
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.split('\n') if ln.strip()]

# Headers and section labels to ignore
ignore = set([
    'Scribe County Public Library','Title','Author','Publisher','Genre','Status','Books',
    "Young Children's",'Middle Grade','Young Adult'
])
filtered = [ln for ln in lines if ln not in ignore]

# Parse in 5-line blocks
records = []
buf = []
for ln in filtered:
    buf.append(ln)
    if len(buf) == 5:
        records.append(buf)
        buf = []

# Build DataFrame
cols = ['Title','Author','Publisher','Genre','Status']
df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=cols)

# Filter Rick Riordan
riordan = df[df['Author'].str.lower().str.contains('rick riordan')].copy()
riordan['Status_norm'] = riordan['Status'].str.lower().str.strip()

# Define not-on-shelf statuses (current assumption): only 'checked out'
not_on_shelves = {'checked out'}
riordan_not_on_shelves = riordan[riordan['Status_norm'].isin(not_on_shelves)]

print('Number of Rick Riordan books not currently on the library\'s shelves:', len(riordan_not_on_shelves))
print('\nTitles and status:')
print(riordan_not_on_shelves[['Title','Status']].to_string(index=False))
